fields.description: WhatsApp number registered on MSG91, digits only. e.g. 919924859743
fields.label: Integrated Number

fields.description: Paste this into MSG91 Dashboard > WhatsApp > Webhook (New), event "On Outbound Report Received". Save this form once after setting the token to generate it.
fields.label: Delivery Report Webhook URL

fields.description: Any long random string. It is the only thing standing between MSG91's callback URL and the public internet.
fields.label: Webhook Token

fields.description: When a contact changes state, push the mapped status onto the matched CRM Lead. Leave off until your states and mappings look right.
fields.label: Auto Write Lead Status

fields.description: Recipient number, digits only with country code. e.g. 919328785200
fields.label: Test To

fields.description: Approved template name on this number's WABA. e.g. test_1
fields.label: Test Template

fields.description: Optional JSON of template variables, e.g. {"body_1": {"type": "text", "value": "Dhruvil"}}
fields.label: Test Components (JSON)

fields.description: Only used once MSG91 free-form/session sending is wired.
fields.label: Test Body (session, not yet supported)
